characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated character sprite atlas for a cozy pixel office game. Create ONE character sprite sheet on genuinely transparent background, no background color, no cast shadow, no grid lines, no text. Requested canvas 1792x1536, STRICT 7 columns by 3 rows, exactly 21 separate complete full-body character frames, every cell equal 256x512, character centered horizontally and feet on a consistent baseline, generous transparent gutters. Each character is about 160px wide and 320px tall within its cell. Original chunky 16-bit RPG chibi pixel art, about two and a half heads tall, hard blocky pixel clusters suitable for downsampling to 16x32 game sprites. Restrained 10-color palette, clear large hair and clothing shapes, simple two-pixel eyes. No anti-aliasing, gradients, painterly rendering, UI, furniture, logos or recognizable franchise motifs. All frames use EXACT same character identity, clothing, scale and alignment. Row 1 all facing SOUTH / front toward viewer, row 2 all facing NORTH / back of head toward viewer, row 3 all facing EAST / right-facing side profile. Seven columns in EVERY row: 1 neutral standing; 2 walking left foot forward; 3 walking right foot forward; 4 working with arms forward at waist; 5 working with arms forward alternate slight hand motion; 6 holding a small open cream notebook; 7 holding that notebook with head slightly inclined. All poses remain upright full body with feet visible. No desk or chair. Change only limbs for animation, heads do not turn within a row. Precisely uniform frame grid; never add extra sprites or omit a cell. Character design: A young adult with a short side-swept teal bob, warm light skin, coral shirt under ivory dungarees, sage shoes. Distinct small leaf-shaped copper hair clip, friendly alert expression. Frontend craftsperson.
